title: Problem
问题
html:
Existing visual reward models are task-specific and cannot share knowledge across image/video understanding and generation or across pairwise and pointwise evaluation. The paper asks whether unified training creates cross-task benefits.

UnifiedReward is trained on large-scale human preferences across image and video understanding and generation. It supports pairwise ranking and pointwise scoring and then automatically constructs high-quality DPO pairs for downstream vision models.

现有视觉RM多针对单一理解或生成任务，无法在图像、视频、pairwise和pointwise评价间共享知识。论文研究统一训练是否产生跨任务协同。

UnifiedReward基于大规模人工偏好数据统一评价图像与视频理解/生成，同时支持pairwiseranking和pointwisescoring；再自动筛选模型输出构造DPO对。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
UnifiedReward is trained on large-scale human preferences across image and video understanding and generation. It supports pairwise ranking and pointwise scoring and then automatically constructs high-quality DPO pairs for downstream vision models.

Human preference data from several visual tasks trains one shared reward model. Pair ranking and point sifting select high- and low-quality model outputs, which are converted into chosen–rejected records and consumed by DPO.

UnifiedReward基于大规模人工偏好数据统一评价图像与视频理解/生成，同时支持pairwiseranking和pointwisescoring；再自动筛选模型输出构造DPO对。

先汇总多任务人工偏好训练统一RM；用pairranking与pointsifting选择高低质量候选，形成新的chosen/rejected数据，并对对应视觉模型执行DPO。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Build a unified human preference mixture. Human preference data from several visual tasks trains one shared reward model.
  2. Train pairwise and pointwise rewards. Pair ranking and point sifting select high- and low-quality model outputs, which are converted into chosen–rejected records and consumed by DPO.
  3. Filter model outputs into DPO pairs. Pair ranking and point sifting select high- and low-quality model outputs, which are converted into chosen–rejected records and consumed by DPO.
  4. Align image and video models. Pair ranking and point sifting select high- and low-quality model outputs, which are converted into chosen–rejected records and consumed by DPO.

1. 构建统一人工偏好混合数据。 先汇总多任务人工偏好训练统一RM；
  2. 训练成对与逐点评分。 用pairranking与pointsifting选择高低质量候选，形成新的chosen/rejected数据，并对对应视觉模型执行DPO。
  3. 将模型输出筛成 DPO 偏好对。 用pairranking与pointsifting选择高低质量候选，形成新的chosen/rejected数据，并对对应视觉模型执行DPO。
  4. 对齐图像与视频模型。 用pairranking与pointsifting选择高低质量候选，形成新的chosen/rejected数据，并对对应视觉模型执行DPO。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Joint reward training improves assessment across all included understanding and generation domains. Preference alignment with automatically selected pairs produces significant downstream improvements in image and video tasks.

Different tasks may have conflicting criteria that a shared scalar hides. Automatically generated preference pairs can feed reward-model bias back into the trained vision models.

多任务联合训练在各理解与生成领域均带来增益，自动构造偏好对后的图像和视频模型也显著改善，支持统一评价与消费链。

不同任务标准可能冲突，统一标量会掩盖差异；自动筛选会把RM偏差反馈给下游模型，数据来源重叠也可能污染评测。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The work unifies understanding, image generation, video generation, pairwise ranking, and pointwise scoring in one reward model. Cross-task assessment is the central contribution.

Existing visual reward models are task-specific and cannot share knowledge across image/video understanding and generation or across pairwise and pointwise evaluation. The paper asks whether unified training creates cross-task benefits.

新意是一个RM横跨理解、图像生成和视频生成，并统一两种评分范式；不是单任务reward的简单扩展。

现有视觉RM多针对单一理解或生成任务，无法在图像、视频、pairwise和pointwise评价间共享知识。论文研究统一训练是否产生跨任务协同。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
1. Primary limitation. Different tasks may have conflicting criteria that a shared scalar hides. It should be calibrated separately by task and compared with human and task-specific rewards.
  2. Curator audit risk. Automatically generated preference pairs can feed reward-model bias back into the trained vision models. Replication should separate dataset artifacts from the claimed mechanism and report failures by task or subgroup.

1. 主要局限。不同任务标准可能冲突，统一标量会掩盖差异；复用时应按任务校准，并与专用RM和人工偏好比较。
  2. 策展审计风险。自动筛选会把RM偏差反馈给下游模型，数据来源重叠也可能污染评测。复现时应把数据 artifact 带来的收益与方法机制分开，并按任务或群体报告失败情况。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
1. Training or data construction. UnifiedReward can rerank multimodal outputs, filter training data, and generate DPO pairs. Success should be checked with the paper’s main held-out metric under a fixed base model and data budget.
  2. Evaluation or auditing. It should be calibrated separately by task and compared with human and task-specific rewards. Do not use the method unchanged when its verifier, rubric, modality, or annotation assumptions do not hold.

1. 训练或数据构造。可用于多模态候选排序、数据过滤与DPO；复用时应固定基础模型与数据预算，并使用论文主要留出指标检查是否真正有效。
  2. 评测或审计。复用时应按任务校准，并与专用RM和人工偏好比较。当任务不满足原论文的 verifier、rubric、模态或标注假设时，不能未经修改直接使用。

  4. Evidence anchor: Joint reward training improves assessment across all included understanding and generation domains.

  2. 方法抓手：关键动作依次是构建统一人工偏好混合数据、训练成对与逐点评分、将模型输出筛成 DPO 偏好对，最后完成对齐图像与视频模型。
  3. 数据抓手：UnifiedReward基于大规模人工偏好数据统一评价图像与视频理解/生成，同时支持pairwiseranking和pointwisescoring；
